apps.name: OptimizeApp
apps.short_description: The easiest way to to launch digital campaigns and drive results.
apps.description:
With OptimizeApp, you can run social media campaigns that show up to users who are most likely to purchase from your store.

 **Connect your Zid store & unlock advanced features**

**-**  **Launch Sales-focused campaigns**
Enable better tracking and revenue reporting for your sales campaigns with Snapchat pixel and CAPI (Conversion API).

**-** **AI audience targeting**.
Let AI do the heavy lifting by finding potential clients that are more likely to purchase from your store.

**-** **Control your online ads on mobile & desktop**
Run your ads directly from inside your Zid dashboard, or download our mobile app to take control on the go.

**Important:** to use OptimizeApp inside the Zid dashboard, you must have the "Snapchat Ads" app downloaded from the Zid App Market and have your pixel connected to your Zid store.


**Activation Process**

1. Activate OptimizeApp from the Zid App Market.

2. If you haven't already, download the "[Snapchat Ads](https://web.zid.sa/market/app/3883)" app and set up your pixel.

3. Share your Snapchat pixel & Public profile with OptimizeApp.

4. Launch your campaigns in minutes.

5. Track your results & optimize your campaigns.

6. [Download the mobile app](https://optimizeapp.com/download) and sign up using your Zid email (optional).

apps.name: Digital Pro
apps.short_description: Integrate with Digital Pro App and print accounting and inventory reports easily and flexibility.
apps.description:
**Overview:**

Digital Pro System is an integrated accounting system approved by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA). It offers innovative solutions for managing the accounting, financial and tax operations of e-commerce stores. It also helps you track your inventory through detailed reports, which contributes to saving time and effort and facilitating store management through automatic data synchronization with accuracy and ease.

**Why Digital Pro?**

Digital Pro is an integrated and customizable accounting system that suits the nature of your company or business activity, which helps you manage your financial affairs correctly and activate the electronic invoice approved by ZATCA.

* Automate your internal tasks: Digital Pro's integration tools enable you to connect inventory, sales, purchasing, and other internal systems, which helps you automate your tasks with ease.

* Approved electronic invoice: Convert paper invoices to electronic invoices that comply with tax and financial aspects and electronic exchange between the seller and the buyer with an easy-to-use program.

* High-precision inventory management.

* Detailed reports for all operations.

* Excellent technical support.

**Key Features of Integration:**

* The integration between "Zid" and "Digital Pro" enables you to track the total sales achieved through the reports within the Digital Pro system, which displays all sales invoices and returns that were created in Zoho.

* Choose the order status from which you want to start the transfer to Digital Pro (completed, for example)

* Put tags on orders that have been transferred to the Digital Pro system

* Comprehensive Reporting Service from Digital Pro System

* The Digital Pro System aims to provide detailed reports to store owners to enable them to manage their businesses efficiently and confidently, saving time and effort in preparing reports and analyzing performance.

* Simple and detailed reports sent to your email at the time you want to improve your store's performance and view the financial data of your sales.

* Ability to issue reports for previous periods: Do you want to issue performance reports for periods prior to subscribing to the service? It's simple, all you have to do is import the operations of those periods and issue your reports with the click of a button.

**Integration Mechanism:**

**1.** Activate the application.

**2.** After activating the application, the activation page will appear on which your ID number is displayed. Copy it.

**3.** Open the advanced Digital Pro program on your device, then go to Tools, then click on the link with the Zoho platform, then paste the number in the ID box, then click on Start linking, then click save.

**4.** The integration has been established directly.

apps.name: Ziadah AI Upsell
apps.short_description: Boost your order with 15 ways using AI-powered recommendations personalized for every customer
apps.description:
### The Best Way to Increase Your Order Value
AI automatically suggests products to your customers – each customer sees personalized recommendations tailored specifically to them, without any intervention from you "and you can customize them if you prefer."

**Over 15 types of smart suggestions:** Quantity offers, "Buy it with," complementary add-ons, coupons, free shipping goals, upgrades, and more...

---

### Success Stories
More than 1,500 stores have trusted Ziadah. You can view some of the stores' performance numbers [**HERE**](https://www.ziadah.app/success-stories).

---

### Try the Suggestions
Experience the app as a customer inside a store [**HERE**](https://ky0vcg.zid.store/)

---

### How Does It Work?
* **Learns from customer behavior:** What they bought, what they viewed, and when they browse.
* **Generates personalized suggestions:** Unique recommendations for every visitor, not fixed for everyone.
* **Smart timing:** Automatically chooses the best moment and location to show the suggestion.
* **Continuous evolution:** The app's performance improves on its own with every impression.
* **Full control:** If you want to add manual suggestions yourself, you can—but we recommend letting the AI handle it because it understands your customer precisely.

> To learn more, click [**HERE**](https://www.ziadah.app/blog/ziadah-ai-smart-recommendations).

---

### What Changes When You Activate Ziadah?
* **Bigger Carts:** Customers buy more than just one product.
* **High Efficiency:** Most orders contain a higher number of items.
* **Sales Growth:** Your Average Order Value (AOV) becomes higher.
* **Cost Savings:** Lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* **Smart Marketing:** Simple products are sold with $0 marketing cost.
* **Flexible Inventory:** Inventory turnover becomes faster and stock clears out intelligently.

Calculate the approximate sales for your store [**HERE**](https://www.ziadah.app/calculator).

---

### What Can You Show Your Customer?
* Products with or without discounts.
* Quantity offers (Buy more, save more).
* Offers to upgrade a product in the cart to a better version.
* Complementary products for the item the customer is currently viewing.
* Over 15 different display methods.

---

### Comprehensive Targeting
Wherever your customer is, they will see suggestions that suit them:

* Adding a product to cart - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/add-to-cart)
* Removing a product from cart - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/remove-from-cart)
* Entering a product page - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/product-page)
* Reaching the checkout page - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/checkout)
* Completing an order (Thank You page) - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/thank-you)
* Store homepage - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/home)
* Opening the cart page - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/cart)
* Entering a specific category page - [**Learn More**](https://www.ziadah.app/use-cases/category)

---

### Activation in 30 Seconds
After that, the app works **24/7** on your behalf – suggesting, selling, and learning.
* **Try it now for free** – Activate in 30 seconds and see the increase from day one.

---

### Pricing
You can view all available plans [**HERE**](https://www.ziadah.app/pricing).
Contact us via WhatsApp, and the plan will be activated for you immediately.

---

### For Support and Inquiries
Contact us via WhatsApp by clicking [**HERE**](https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=966510131856)
